title: Missable-safe platinum route
intro: Follow the stages in this order. Every chapter-locked trophy is cleared before its chapter ends, and the platinum is left for the very last line.

stages.goal: Clear Gone Fishing and save before you leave the prologue.
missable_warnings: Gone Fishing cannot be replayed from chapter select; finish it on the first run.

stages.goal: Finish the chapter and the named mission together.
missable_warnings: Breakfast Run is only available while Chapter 1 is active.

stages.goal: Clear the chapter, its two missions and both partner events.
missable_warnings: The Cartel Heist and Child's Play close with the chapter.
Hot Together and Retail Therapy use a partner window that does not return.

stages.goal: Complete the chapter and both of its mission awards.
missable_warnings: Headliners and VCIA Takedown are locked once the chapter ends.

stages.goal: Finish the chapter and its final named mission.
missable_warnings: Operation Savage Glory disappears after the Chapter 4 finale.

stages.goal: Play the final mission from a dedicated pre-finale save.
missable_warnings: Keep the pre-finale save until every missable row is ticked.

stages.goal: Work the counts and collectible tables region by region.
missable_warnings: No trophy in this stage is missable, but several partner moments are story-window locked.

stages.goal: Fill the last completion gaps, then collect the platinum.
missable_warnings: The platinum cannot register until every other trophy is earned.
